title: ALPR vendor contracts and shared-access arrangements within city limits

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Kansas Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

records created or received since January 1, 2020 concerning automated license
plate reader (ALPR/LPR) technology. Public statements indicate the department
uses Genetec and LSAG equipment and does not use Flock Safety. I request
records to verify that: (1) all contracts, purchase orders, invoices, leases,
and grant agreements for any ALPR equipment physically located within the City
of Overland Park, including units owned or installed by third parties such as
homeowners associations, businesses, or other agencies; (2) any agreement,
including Flock Safety's Safety Network or equivalent, granting this agency
access to query data collected by non-City ALPR systems, or granting any other
agency or vendor access to data collected by City systems; (3) a list of ALPR
vendors in use by vendor name; (4) the department's ALPR policy and all prior
versions from 2024 to present; and (5) correspondence with the ACLU of Kansas,
city council members, or counsel regarding ALPR policy revisions.

I do not request records containing captured license plate data or the location
of any ALPR, and I do not request records exempt under K.S.A. 45-221(a)(55).
I am a Kansas resident. Please provide records electronically in native format.
If fees will exceed $25, please contact me first. If any record is withheld,
please cite the specific statute and release all segregable, non-exempt portions.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jonathan Modisett

title: Flock Safety / ALPR contracts, policies, and audit reports (no plate data or camera locations)

communications.subject: The Kansas Open Records Act Request: Flock Safety / ALPR contracts, policies, and audit reports (no plate data or camera locations)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Kansas Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

records created or received since January 1, 2022 concerning automated license
plate reader (ALPR/LPR) technology used by this agency. I do not request any
records containing captured license plate data or the location of any ALPR, and
I do not request records exempt under K.S.A. 45-221(a)(55). Specifically:

1. Contracts, purchase orders, invoices, and grant agreements with Flock Safety,
Genetec, LSAG, or any other ALPR vendor, including any amendments, and including
how the initial deployment was funded, with any grant applications or award
documents referencing ALPR or LPR equipment;

2. Any policy, directive, standard operating procedure, or written authorization
governing ALPR use, retention, audits, or queries, including all prior versions;

3. Any data-sharing or information-sharing agreement with Flock Safety or any
other agency permitting queries of this agency's ALPR data or of data held by
third parties;

4. Monthly or periodic query-audit reports, compliance reports, and any internal
or external audit of ALPR use, with license plate values and location data
redacted;

5. Records of requests for ALPR data from other law enforcement agencies or
federal agencies, and the disposition of those requests, again with plate values
and locations redacted;

6. Correspondence, including emails and attachments, among agency staff,
policymaking bodies, or counsel regarding ALPRs, Flock Safety, retention periods,
or public records requests for ALPR records.

I am a Kansas resident. Please provide records electronically in native format.
If fees will exceed $25, please contact me first. If any record is withheld,
please cite the specific statute and segregate and release all editable,
non-exempt portions.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jonathan Modisett

title: Johnson County data center development records (Beale, QTS, Spring Hill) (Johnson County)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the The Kansas Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

records created or received between January 1, 2024 and today concerning data
center development in unincorporated Johnson County, including proposals by
Beale Infrastructure (including "Project Pilot" and "Project Brewer"), Bullock
Capital or Colossus (Spring Hill), and QTS or Van Trust Real Estate (New
Century Commerce Center). Specifically:

1. Applications, rezoning or unified development ordinance filings, hearings,
site plans, and staff reports;

2. Memoranda of understanding, incentive or economic development agreements,
and any agreements involving payments to residents;

3. Correspondence, including emails and attachments, between county staff,
elected officials, or the County Attorney and any representative, consultant,
or lobbyist of the above companies;

4. Requests to or communications with Evergy, Johnson County Water District
No. 1 (WaterOne), or the Kansas Department of Health and Environment regarding
water, sewer, or electrical capacity for these projects;

5. Internal emails among members of the Board of County Commissioners, county
counsel, or planning staff referencing "data center," the company names, or the
project names above.

I am a Kansas resident. Please provide responsive records electronically in
native format. If this request will require more than one hour of staff time,
please contact me to narrow it before assessing fees.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Jonathan Modisett
